changes.decision: updated_at is null exactly for revision 0; persisted revisions require an aware timestamp
changes.reason: docs/08_CLIENT_API.md explicitly requires a missing pre-message draft to return revision 0; no persisted timestamp exists. This resolves a static schema inconsistency rather than inventing a date.

changes.decision: created_at is nullable only where the historical source has no recorded timestamp; new notice source inserts persist actual creation time
changes.reason: The existing communication_notices row has no timestamp. Preserving old data cannot recover a historical instant, and adoption time is not notice creation time. API returns honest null for those legacy rows.

changes.decision: Require attachment_total_bytes, attachment_staging_bytes, attachment_project_staging_bytes and attachment_staging_seconds; zero means disabled capacity.
changes.reason: The package requires the aggregate per-message attachment budget to be advertised before enforcement, but upstream Meta lacks it. Bounded staging also needs explicit viewer/project quotas and TTL. Original devpack contracts remain unchanged.

changes.decision: Project the verified host_ref/provider_generation and require expected_host_ref/expected_provider_generation on writes.
changes.reason: The integration NativeSessionRef requires exact Host and generation; optimistic body strings are never proof. Current Core/Host authorization and registry evidence remain independent.

changes.decision: Require native_link_count, native_link_history_revisions, native_link_write_receipts and native_link_metadata_bytes; zero means feature disabled.
changes.reason: Expose bounded link/history/receipt/metadata admission capacity before enforcing the optional service, without revealing private usage.

changes.decision: Add optional NativeSourceLookup/SourceLink/NativeSourceSession for explicit include_native_source reads; the existing22 P1 operations remain unchanged.
changes.reason: Exact original Core dispatch and Node journal evidence are distinct from mutable Slot/Session association. Current participant ACL and registration fences bracket the private read; an unavailable source is typed, never guessed from text or current sessions. No Native transcript/action permission is granted.

scope: v1.1.0 P0/P1/P2 delivery tiers supersede the old full-WP completion gate. The full contract and implemented optional features are retained. Runtime /meta and source-bound acceptance evidence determine availability; P1 contract readiness does not qualify an Orca Host.
